text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Oaks. Spectators'

expectations are running high thanks to
Hishi
Amazon's strong performance at
the Oka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Similarly, Нарита Брайан crushed the
Satsuki Sho,
winning the first leg of the
Triple Crown. Hishi
Amazon is extra
pumped—she can't back down
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
